_doc: FICTIONAL sample family. Copy this file, fill in your customer's data, run: node tools/family/build.js my-family.json ../out/my-family   (keys starting with _ are ignored)

edition._id_doc: latin slug a-z 0-9 - ; used for the browser storage key so editions never share progress
edition._title_doc: null = '<kid1> و<kid2>' (e.g. ياسين وسلمى). Or write your own title.
edition.subtitle: يوميات ومغامرات

kids._slot: SLOT 1 = the OLDER playable child (drawn tall/strong: lifts heavy things, reaches high places, gets the harder puzzles).
kids.name: ياسين
kids._nick_doc: nick = the name shown in the game / used by the narrator; name = full name (shown in parent corner only). nick defaults to name.

kids._slot: SLOT 2 = the YOUNGER playable child (drawn small/quick: fits through gaps, crawls under furniture, easier puzzles). The base game has a boy here; gender 'f' re-words the lines and re-dresses the character.
kids.name: سلمى

kids._slot: SLOT 3 = an OLDER sibling (leader/organiser, controllable in the grandparent and trip worlds).
kids.name: جنى

extraChildren._doc: Used ONLY to fill slot 4 (or 3) when the family has fewer than 4 children: a cousin / neighbour. The story shows 4 kids in the grandparent and trip worlds.
extraChildren.name: كريم

parents._doc: the words the children use. Only change if the family says e.g. 'بابي' / 'مامي'.

dad._status_doc: 'abroad' = he works far away: keeps the trip world («السفر لبابا») and the daily video call. 'home' = both are REMOVED.

grandparent._doc: The grandparent world is built around the lift of the building where the family lives. sameBuilding=false removes that world.
grandparent.title: تيتة
grandparent.name: سميرة

home._doc: Used in the trip world only (departure airport, 'gifts from home'). Egyptian general-knowledge questions (capital, Nile, emergency numbers) are NOT changed: see README.

destination._preset_doc: 'abha' = keep the original trip (Abha, Asir). 'custom' = replace names + factual questions with the data below. The SCENERY (misty mountains, cable car, stone towers) stays: choose a similar place or edit by hand.
destination._facts_doc: VERIFY every fact with a reliable source before selling. Missing facts fall back to neutral questions (see build-report.json).
